title: Vulkan Compute Dispatch Without Descriptor Flush
description: Vulkan compute dispatches (vkCmdDispatch) require descriptors to be bound via vkCmdBindDescriptorSets with VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE before dispatch. If the descriptor flush only happens in the draw path (DrawIndexed/Draw) but not in Dispatch(), compute shaders read from stale/empty descriptor sets. Additionally, FlushDescriptorSet must use the correct bind point — using VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS for a compute dispatch silently fails.
whenToUse: Any Vulkan backend that shares command list implementation between graphics and compute pipelines. Track m_computePipelineBound in SetPipeline() and use it in FlushDescriptorSet().
whenNotToUse: Backends that use separate command lists for compute — the bind point is always COMPUTE.
